title: Border beam
description: A small traveling light traces the edge of a focused surface.
useCase: Draw attention to a single interactive area or a temporary working state, with quiet content inside.
reducedMotion: A stationary border accent replaces the traveling light.
limitations: Uses CSS offset-path and masking. Treat the accent as decorative, never the only status indicator.
look: Dark olive-charcoal page with a rounded, slightly lighter prompt card holding a textarea, a muted green square send button and a pale green border highlight.
motion: A 90 px pale-green gradient travels the card's rounded 1 px border along a CSS motion path, one linear lap every 5 s, looping until paused.
adapt: The beam is `.mg-border-light` moving along `offsetPath` via the `mg-border-trace` keyframes (5s linear); its parent's `maskComposite` limits it to a 1 px ring. Match `round 17px` and `borderRadius` to your surface, tune size and gradient, and replace the idea form.
